record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the tied item table and unit normalization, but introduce one jointly learned positive coordinate gain shared by history and candidate embeddings: normalize(embedding_i*exp(g)), with g initialized to zero. This preserves the incumbent initial representation while allowing the single network to learn which embedding coordinates matter. Preserve dimensions, GRU topology, scoring formula, history policy, loss and optimizer. Save g in the single checkpoint and update the predictor writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Learn a positive coordinate gain shared by tied history and candidate embeddings in each category's single GRU4Rec model. Zero-initialized log gains preserve the initial unit-normalized representation while allowing coordinate importance to adapt. Keep dimensions, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.
